title: Fixed Drum-Cased Grain Winnower
description: One newly authored whole static post-harvest grain-cleaner appearance: a broad horizontal rounded fan housing on a four-legged timber frame, a square open tapering hopper above it, a long downward open discharge trough, and a side offset hand crank with wooden grip. Fourteen closed editable meshes and four constant opaque PBR roles. This is not the old upright coffee hand grinder, tall ribbed silo, twin-wheel bench grinder or stand-alone sieve. The hopper has a real isolated open throat and the trough real upper space; the hidden machine interior, fan blades, screen, gears and continuous internal grain/air connection are deliberately not modeled. Housing is a closed display solid. No animation, airflow, grain separation, milling, harvesting efficiency, real engineering, food-use or historic replica claim. Metres, Z up, actual whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin; small fixed hidden overlaps support the static display.
